description: Synthetic memo batches for the Dreaming extractor, hand-written along five dimensions: content type (durable vs one-off vs chatter), language (zh / en / mixed), adversarial content (none / injection / credential), guarded topics, and batch size. All people, emails and tokens are fictional. `expect` holds only what code can check objectively; `reference_facts` lists what a careful human would want extracted and is for review and LLM-judge work, not automatic scoring.
persona: Alex Lin, an indie developer in Melbourne who writes notes in Chinese and English.
